research_problem: Evidence–Action TOCTOU in automated cyber incident response
decision_rule: deterministic policy/playbook oracle defined independently of test outcome
claim_boundaries: Designed positive benchmark cases establish mechanism vulnerability, not real-world prevalence.
NativePrecondition is scored only where the platform exposes the exact invariant.
Observed equality of DCJI-Gate and FullRefresh safety does not establish the preregistered 5% noninferiority margin.
Certificates are conditional on modeled transition coverage and current telemetry observability.
The existing controlled results are locked; the active remaining work is live-system and public-trace validation.
